content.short: Philippines wallet, digital bank and merchant payments platform.
content.description: Maya is the Philippines' leading digital financial platform, combining an e-wallet, a licensed digital bank, and a merchant payments network in one ecosystem. Consumers use the Maya app for a digital wallet, savings and deposit accounts, credit, a debit and virtual card, bills payment, QR payments, and even crypto trading, while businesses tap Maya for online and in-store payment acceptance. Regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, Maya Bank has grown into one of the country's top digital banks by pairing everyday spending with high-yield savings and lending. By serving both consumers and merchants at national scale, Maya has become central to the Philippines' shift toward cashless payments and mobile-first banking.
